verdict.rationale: Sumsub's liveness documentation explicitly names several spoofing vectors it defends against — deepfakes, AI-generated images, paper masks, photos of a screen, and dolls — going beyond generic marketing language (sumsub-docs-12), and provides a review workflow for liveness results (sumsub-docs-13). However, there is no explicit mention of 'camera injection' as a named attack category or technical detail on the detection method (e.g., depth sensing, passive vs active liveness architecture), nor independent/third-party validation of these claims. Missing for 10: explicit camera-injection defense naming, technical/architectural detail on how detection works, and independent test corroboration.
